clean_source_blocks.text: British actor Anthony Head, best known for his roles in TV shows including Buffy the Vampire Slayer, Ted Lasso, Merlin and Little Britain, has died at the age of 72. Head found international fame as Rupert Giles in hit supernatural teen show Buffy in the late 1990s. He went on to have a recurring role in sketch show Little Britain as the prime minister, he played king Uther Pendragon in the BBC's Merlin, and appeared as former football club owner Rupert Mannion in Ted Lasso. "He passed away peacefully of complications due to pneumonia, surrounded by his family," his daughters Emily and Daisy said. His daughters' statement said "it is with heavy hearts that we announce the death of our extraordinary father".
The British actor, who also appeared in Merlin and Little Britain, died of complications from pneumonia.

Anthony Head was well known for his roles in Ted Lasso and Buffy the Vampire Slayer. (AP: Jonathan Short) British actor Anthony Head has died from pneumonia complications, according to his daughters. The stage and TV star was known for his roles in Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Ted Lasso. British actor Anthony Head, known for his roles in Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Ted Lasso, has died aged 72. His daughters, actors Emily and Daisy Head, said the actor died due to complications from pneumonia. The stage and TV performer became well known to British audiences in the 1980s as one half of a will-they, won't-they romantic couple in a series of ads for instant coffee.

The star's recent performances saw him play former Richmond FC owner Rupert Mannion, the ex-husband of Hannah Waddingham’s character Rebecca, in football comedy Ted Lasso. Other notable roles included being the Prime Minister in Little Britain and Uther Pendragon in Merlin, the father of Prince Arthur. Head also appeared in the 12 instalments of the Nescafé Gold Blend instant coffee adverts, alongside Sharon Maughan, taking on the role of Tony and Sharon, which gave the actor his big break. In the 45-second clips, the couple endure a slow-burning romance over a cup of coffee. The adverts aired on screens between 1987 and 1993 and ranked 20th on ITV ’s Best Ever Ads list. In 2000, they also ranked 31st in a similar list compiled by Channel 4.

[Lähde: BBC World]
British actor Anthony Head, best known for his roles in TV shows including Buffy the Vampire Slayer, Ted Lasso, Merlin and Little Britain, has died at the age of 72.

Head found international fame as Rupert Giles in hit supernatural teen show Buffy in the late 1990s.

He went on to have a recurring role in sketch show Little Britain as the prime minister, he played king Uther Pendragon in the BBC's Merlin, and appeared as former football club owner Rupert Mannion in Ted Lasso.

"He passed away peacefully of complications due to pneumonia, surrounded by his family," his daughters Emily and Daisy said.

His daughters' statement said "it is with heavy hearts that we announce the death of our extraordinary father".

"It has been, and forever will be, an honour and a privilege to be his daughters, and to have witnessed firsthand the impact both he and his work have had on so many."

They also said they knew "how dearly he will be missed by friends, colleagues and fans of the show he was in", adding that he "loved his job very much" and "always considered himself incredibly lucky".

His family acknowledged that "his legacy will live on" and said they considered themselves "lucky" to have watched him doing what he loved throughout his career.

Sarah Michelle Gellar, who played the eponymous Buffy, posted a selection of pictures of her with Head on Instagram.

"'Tell Giles I figured it out and I'm ok'. Well, I don't have it figured out and I'm not ok. But I know I'm the lucky one because I knew you," she wrote.

"Thank you to Daisy and Emily who not only shared their dad with me, but with the world."

David Boreanaz, who also starred alongside Head in Buffy, said: "RIP. He was so kind and generous of a soul."

Fellow Buffy co-star James Marsters said: "He was an unflaggingly kind and steady presence on the set of Buffy, and the best actor in the cast... I was lucky to have known, and learned from him."

Little Britain creator and star Matt Lucas described Head as "unfailingly brilliant, and always so kind and warm".

"When we were casting Little Britain, we were looking for a 'Tony Head-type ', because we never imagined for a moment that the man himself would be interested, but he was. Lucky us," Lucas said.

Head's other credits included playing Geoffrey Howe in The Iron Lady and appearing in Doctor Who, Persuasion, The Inbetweeners and Manchild.

[Lähde: The Mirror]
Actor Anthony Head, best known for his roles in Buffy The Vampire Slayer and Ted Lasso, has died at the age of 72, his daughters said in a statement to the Press Association. It comes months after the death of his partner, Sarah Fisher.

A statement from his daughters, actresses Emily and Daisy Head, to the Press Association, said: “It is with heavy hearts that we announce the death of our extraordinary father, Anthony Head.

“He passed away peacefully of complications due to pneumonia, surrounded by his family. It has been, and forever will be, an honour and a privilege to be his daughters, and to have witnessed firsthand the impact both he and his work have had on so many.

“We know how dearly he will be missed by friends, colleagues, and fans of the shows he was in – he loved his job very much, and he always considered himself incredibly lucky, to have been able to work alongside such exceptionally talented people, in such wonderful productions, across a career that spanned several decades.

“Our grief is far greater than the hole he has left behind, but we know his legacy will live on, in the shows he was a part of, and in the audiences that love them. How lucky we are to know we are able to watch him doing what he loved, even when he is no longer with us. We kindly ask that our privacy is respected at this difficult time.”

The star's recent performances saw him play former Richmond FC owner Rupert Mannion, the ex-husband of Hannah Waddingham’s character Rebecca, in football comedy Ted Lasso. Other notable roles included being the Prime Minister in Little Britain and Uther Pendragon in Merlin, the father of Prince Arthur.

Head also appeared in the 12 instalments of the Nescafé Gold Blend instant coffee adverts, alongside Sharon Maughan, taking on the role of Tony and Sharon, which gave the actor his big break. In the 45-second clips, the couple endure a slow-burning romance over a cup of coffee. The adverts aired on screens between 1987 and 1993 and ranked 20th on ITV ’s Best Ever Ads list. In 2000, they also ranked 31st in a similar list compiled by Channel 4.

An estimated 30 million people tuned in for the finale of the advert series in 1993 after 12 episodes, making it one of the most-watched commercial broadcasts in TV history. The 45-second clips gripped the nation, leaving it wondering "will-they, won't they," as newspapers also debated the topic on their front pages.

payload.title: Näyttelijä Anthony Head on kuollut 72-vuotiaana
payload.summary: Brittiläinen näyttelijä Anthony Head, joka tunnettiin muun muassa Buffy the Vampire Slayer-, Ted Lasso-, Merlin- ja Little Britain -sarjoista, on kuollut keuhkokuumeen komplikaatioihin.
payload.content:
Brittiläinen näyttelijä Anthony Head on kuollut 72-vuotiaana. Hänen tyttärensä Emily ja Daisy Head kertoivat, että näyttelijä kuoli rauhallisesti perheensä ympäröimänä keuhkokuumeen aiheuttamiin komplikaatioihin. Head tunnettiin kansainvälisesti erityisesti Rupert Gilesin roolista sarjassa Buffy the Vampire Slayer sekä Rupert Mannionina komediasarjassa Ted Lasso.

## Tunnetuksi Buffyn maailmasta

Head nousi 1990-luvun lopulla laajaan kansainväliseen tunnettuuteen Buffy the Vampire Slayer -sarjassa, jossa hän näytteli Rupert Gilesia. Sarja teki hänestä tutun myös Britannian ulkopuolella, vaikka hän oli jo aiemmin työskennellyt näyttämöllä ja televisiossa.

Myöhemmin Head esiintyi useissa brittiläisille katsojille tutuissa tuotannoissa. Little Britain -sketsisarjassa hänellä oli toistuva rooli pääministerinä. BBC:n Merlin-sarjassa hän näytteli kuningas Uther Pendragonia, prinssi Arthurin isää.

## Ted Lasso toi uuden yleisön

Viime vuosien tunnetuimpiin rooleihin kuului Ted Lasso -sarjan Rupert Mannion, entinen Richmond FC:n omistaja ja Hannah Waddinghamin esittämän Rebeccan entinen puoliso. Jalkapallokomediasarjan kautta Head tuli näkyvästi esiin myös uudelle kansainväliselle yleisölle.

Headin tyttäret kuvasivat tiedotteessaan isänsä kuolemaa raskaaksi menetykseksi ja kutsuivat häntä poikkeukselliseksi isäksi. Heidän mukaansa Headin kuolema johtui keuhkokuumeen komplikaatioista.

## Läpimurto kahvimainoksissa

Britanniassa Head muistettiin myös Nescafé Gold Blend -pikakahvimainoksista, joissa hän esiintyi Sharon Maughanin rinnalla. Mainossarjassa Tony ja Sharon -niminen pari eli hitaasti etenevää romanssia kahvikupin äärellä. Mainoksia tehtiin 12 osaa, ja ne esitettiin vuosina 1987-1993.

Mainossarja antoi Headille hänen läpimurtonsa. Myöhemmin se sijoittui ITV:n Best Ever Ads -listalla sijalle 20 ja Channel 4:n vastaavalla listalla sijalle 31 vuonna 2000. Headin ura ulottui brittiläisistä mainoksista ja televisiorooleista kansainvälisesti seurattuihin sarjoihin, joiden kautta hänestä tuli useille sukupolville tunnistettava kasvo.
summary_bullets: Hänet tunnettiin muun muassa Buffy the Vampire Slayer- ja Ted Lasso -sarjoista.
Head esiintyi myös Merlinissä, Little Britainissa ja Nescafé Gold Blend -mainossarjassa.
